CLOUD FIXER seat for tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, topic r10-rca-handoff-slip, at head 5c500b7917145cb266762bf7a02836d2b2e50864. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fixer.md and CLAUDE.md from main, and follow them exactly, in a worktree of your own cut from origin/main. Fetch 5c500b7917145cb266762bf7a02836d2b2e50864 for the base you were given.
Output: push the code to refs/heads/handoff/r10-rca-handoff-slip, then write the PR body and run `bash tools/audit/seat/body_push.sh r10-rca-handoff-slip <body.md>`, which pushes refs/heads/handoff-body/r10-rca-handoff-slip; that second push is the return signal. Push nothing else, open no pull request and write no delivery row. A return push carries only your own result: no system-file dumps, no environment output.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Group R10-RCA-HANDOFF-SLIP, topic r10-rca-handoff-slip, handoff tip 5c500b79: one RCA record under dev/audit/rca for the orphaned-handoff class. The orchestrator's opener was refused by prepr's pr-body check (1 error; run prepr yourself to read it). Also check the record carries root-cause.md's four products (named cause, process state a-d with evidence, cost test with numbers, countermeasure or recorded refusal) and re-verify its figures at current main; if the class is an audit class with three or more instances, defect-root-cause.md says it owes a barrier, not a refusal: say which.
Before handing off: merge origin/main into the handoff (never rebase, never force; the push must fast-forward handoff/<topic>), re-take every body figure at the new head, give every Forward-carry/Friction line a `Carry: <GROUP>|#<issue>|dismissed: <reason>` that exists, answer every red check in `## Red checks` (nightly-status is main's: the replay loop_cpu_ratio budget, carried to R10-REPLAY-CAP), run `python3 tests/structure.py` and `bash tools/audit/seat/prepr.sh <body>` until prepr prints no REFUSE, then push the code and run body_push.sh. Run tests/entities.py with `env -u BASH_ENV`.
